title: Dag Flow Procedural Lod Window Options
description: Add puzzle 2d style LOD window select options to dag, flow, and procedural play shells with wasm manual/automatic LOD support.
summary: Node label text now keeps a fixed screen size within each LOD band. Removed the compact-tier 10px label size so overview/compact/normal share DAG_LABEL_SCREEN_PX (11px). IO widget vertical names no longer use a 1.05× multiplier versus computation stacked names. Wheel zoom again pins draw LOD for the gesture (wheel_zoom_render_lod wired into draw_lod_for_frame) so automatic mode does not swap label layout/size mid-zoom; manual forced LOD still wins.
